title.narrative: Systemic support to Health Services in Haiti - Haiti (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Haiti, RSSH, Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Population (Unité de Gestion des Projets) (Unite de Gestion des projets)This program has the following goals: Mettre fin à l’épidémie de tuberculose d'ici à 2035 / Ending the tuberculosis epidemic by 2035. Maitriser et stopper la progression de l’épidémie de VIH au sein de la population haïtienne par des interventions de qualité qui respectent les droits et la dignité humaine / To control and halt the progression of the HIV epidemic in the Haitian population through quality interventions that respect human rights and dignity. Réduire à zéro l’incidence des cas autochtones de la malaria en Haïti d’ici décembre 2025 / Reduce the incidence of indigenous cases of malaria in Haiti to zero by December 2025. The objectives of this program are: 3 new CDAIs renovated and equipped to national standards 3 nouveaux CDAI sont renovés et equipés en fonction des normes nationales. The destruction of PPI is carried out to standard at the 10 sites equipped with incinerators by 2025. La destruction des PPI est assurée selon les normes dans les 10 sites équipés en incinérateurs d'ici 2025. By 2024, molecular analyzers will be operational in 100% of target institutions. D'ici 2024 les analyseurs moléculaires sont fonctionnels dans 100% dans les institutions cibles. Completeness of reports from epidemiological surveillance sites to reach 95% by 2025 La complétude des rapports des sites de surveillance epidemiologique atteint 95% en 2025. By 2025, 100% of ASCPs will benefit from ongoing training on the 3 priority programs D'ici 2025, 100% des ASCP bénéficie de la formation continue sur les 3 programmes prioritaires. D’ici à fin 2023, dans un environnement légal défini et favorable aux droits des PVVIH, la stigmatisation et la discrimination des PVVIH et des populations clés a baissé de 80% / By the end of 2023, in a defined legal environment that is supportive of the rights of PLHIV, stigma and discrimination against PLHIV and key populations has been reduced by 80%. 100% des populations dans les zones touchées ont accès à un diagnostic précoce soutenu par un programme d’assurance qualité et ont accès à un traitement efficace sans délai / 100% of populations in affected areas have access to early diagnosis supported by a quality assurance programme and have access to effective treatment without delay. Renforcer la surveillance de la malaria et le suivi et l'évaluation du programme à tous les niveaux, y compris au niveau institutionnel et au niveau communautaire / Strengthen malaria surveillance and programme monitoring and evaluation at all levels, including the institutional and community levels. 100% des foyers de la malaria aurait accès aux mesures efficaces de protection contre la malaria / 100% of malaria outbreaks would have access to effective malaria protection measures. Contribuer par des interventions de communication efficaces à l’élimination de la transmission locale de la malaria en Haïti d’ici décembre 2025 / Contribute through effective communication interventions to the elimination of local transmission of malaria in Haiti by December 2025

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for HTI-S-UGPP01
HSS O-Other-6: Percentage of CHWs who benefit from a supportive supervision during the period and comply with minimum requirements in terms of equipment, materials and knowledge/practices
HSS O-Other 5: Annual blood examination rate: per 100 population per year (Elimination settings)

HSS O-Other-3: TB treatment coverage: Percentage of new and relapse cases that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB cases in the same year (all form of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed)
HSS O-Other 2: Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed

HSS O-Other 4: Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases

National aggregate HMIS fully deployed and functional: Percentage of HMIS components in place (HIS deployment, completeness, timeliness, and integration of aggregate disease reporting for HIV, TB and malaria indicators)
HSS O-Other 1: Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period
Impact indicators targets and results for HTI-S-UGPP01
HSS I-Other 2: Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
HSS I-Other 5: Annual parasite incidence: Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year (Elimination settings)
HSS I-Other 1: Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
HSS I-Other 3: TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
HSS I-Other 4: TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for HTI-S-UGPP01
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
LAB Other-3 Number of laboratories who comply with national standard requirements in terms of infrastructure and equipment according to a qualified supervision visit during the reporting period
Proportion of community health workers who received at least one supportive supervision during the reporting period
PSM Other-1 Percentage of health facilities that submitted complete inventory control reports on time, according to an established schedule, during a defined period

LAB Other-2 Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy (TB, Malaria), RDTs (HIV) and VL (HIV) among the total number of laboratories that undertake these tests during the reporting period
LAB Other-1 Percentage of satellite diagnostic services for HIV and TB at health facility level who have received their tests results during the reporting period
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Percentage of health facilities providing diagnostic services with tracer items available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
HRH- Other-1 Number of community health workers who received comprehensive training during the period
